title: Planeó una masacre escolar con ChatGPT, intervino el FBI y no recibirá ninguna pena

reports.title: Un adolescente planificó con la Inteligencia Artificial matar a sus compañeros de colegio: fue detectado por el FBI y allanado en Quilmes
Cómo descubrió el FBI al chico de 15 años que organizaba con IA una masacre escolar en Quilmes y cuál era su plan
Un adolescente planificó con Inteligencia Artificial matar a sus compañeros: el FBI dio aviso y lo allanaron en Quilmes
Planeó una masacre escolar con ChatGPT, intervino el FBI y no recibirá ninguna pena

summary:
A 15-year-old boy in Quilmes, Argentina, allegedly used ChatGPT to plan a school shooting and kill classmates. The FBI's legal office in Buenos Aires alerted local authorities after detecting his conversation, in which he said he wanted to carry out the attack, originally set for 2027 but possibly sooner, and to buy tactical clothing. Argentine Federal Police anti-terrorism detectives identified him and raided his home.

Officers seized two cell phones, two pairs of tactical gloves, a military camo cap, two balaclavas, one with a skull design, and protective goggles. Juvenile prosecutor Walter Bruno is leading the case, and Judge Miriam Alcolcel ordered the search. The boy and his parents have been summoned to the prosecutor's office, while the seized items remain in custody for the public intimidation investigation.
title_en: He planned a school massacre with ChatGPT, the FBI intervened and he will receive no punishment
